# **Title: 8 Bad Habits that KILL Small Channels**

These bad YouTube habits and mindsets could end your YouTube journey before it even really begins. Today we'll be addressing 8 things I personally had to do (or stop doing) in order to keep growing my small YouTube channel. These range from the classic mistakes such as burning out because of a strict, arbitrary upload schedule, to less likely realizations such as WATCHING more YouTube videos rather than just making them all the time.
